verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for a developer-facing payments API. The pack shows no interactive reference or runnable try-it examples: it documents only a generated OpenAPI client, an llms.txt index and markdown docs, and the OpenAPI spec paths probed all returned 404. A keyless live discovery endpoint is a separate capability and does not count as an interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
